question: The average weather pattern taken over a long time, say 25 years is called ______ of the place.
solution:
The correct answer is __Climate:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The average weather pattern taken over a long time, say 25 years, is called the climate of the place.
 
• Whereas, the weather is defined as the atmospheric condition of a place for a short duration of time.
 
• Ecology is a branch of biology that studies and deals with the relationship organisms have with their physical surroundings and also with one another.
 
• Environment, in general terms, is the natural world or surroundings in which all humans, plants, and animals live.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__Ecology-

 
• Ecology is the study of organisms, the environment, and how the organisms interact with each other and their environment.
 
• It is studied at various levels, such as organism, population, community, biosphere and ecosystem.

Environment-

 
• The place, people, things, and nature that surround any living organism are called the environment.
 
• It is a combination of natural and human-made phenomena.
 
• **Landforms are important for determining the suitability of an area for human settlement, agriculture, and other economic activities.**
